description: This source file defines the ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to provide a list of gateway URIs for Orleans clusters using ZooKeeper for service discovery and membership information.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to supply gateway URIs based on ZooKeeper membership data.

methods.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the provider, currently a no-op.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from ZooKeeper membership data.

methods.description: Property indicating the maximum staleness duration for the gateway list.

methods.description: Indicates whether the gateway list is dynamically updatable.
